source_semantics.trigger: The visible Refresh data control calls LoadMetadataClickedAsync, which delegates to the same LoadMetadataAsync routine used for initial AI Center metadata loading.
source_semantics.prompts: The source clears and rebuilds the prompt options from the current-culture prompt registry in case-insensitive key order.
source_semantics.usage: The source recalculates the count from at most the 100 most recent usage records owned by the current user.
source_semantics.sites: The source rereads the sites available to the active AI Center context.
source_semantics.approval: The same load refreshes the current approval status after the other metadata reads.
source_semantics.failure: A metadata load exception is surfaced through the localized error surface; success is not fabricated.

laravel_adaptation.visible_control: backend/resources/js/pages.tsx marks the AI Center Refresh data button with AIMW-AI-953A6C0D98, disables it while the authoritative refetch is in flight, and replaces the visible metadata snapshot only from the Laravel GET response.
laravel_adaptation.endpoint: GET /api/tenants/{tenant}/ai-center remains the existing read-only AI Center contract under web + auth + tenant.context and AiCenterReadController authorizes ai.use.
laravel_adaptation.prompts: AiCenterReadController rereads only enabled tenant-scoped AiPromptTemplate rows and returns them in case-insensitive stable-key order without inventing locale variants that the Laravel schema does not store.
laravel_adaptation.locale: The response records the active Laravel locale so the snapshot truthfully identifies the current localization context without fabricating translated prompt rows.
laravel_adaptation.usage: The controller rereads only AiUsageRecord rows whose user_id is the authenticated user and caps the authoritative count at the 100 newest rows.
laravel_adaptation.sites: The controller rereads Site through the tenant global scope and returns only the allowlisted id and name fields; connector URLs, credentials and secrets are not exposed by this metadata surface.
laravel_adaptation.approval: The controller rereads only the latest Approval whose actor_user_id is the authenticated user and returns the same safe status fields as the dedicated approval-status read contract.
laravel_adaptation.truthful_failure: The frontend uses TanStack Query refetch state/error handling. It does not optimistically change prompt, usage, site or approval metadata and does not report a synthetic successful refresh when the server read fails.

tenant_and_security.current_user_usage: Recent usage is filtered by the authenticated server-side user ID.
tenant_and_security.current_user_approval: Approval status is filtered by the authenticated server-side user ID.
tenant_and_security.tenant_scoped_prompts_sites: Prompt and site models retain BelongsToTenant global scoping under the active TenantContext.
tenant_and_security.secret_surface: The snapshot allowlists site id/name only and returns no provider key, connector secret, WordPress credential, token or encrypted secret.
tenant_and_security.external_runtime: This operation is read-only and requires no live provider, WordPress, email, payment, DNS or production mutation evidence.

proofs: exact canonical operation identity and visible Refresh data production marker
existing authenticated tenant-context GET route is reused rather than duplicated
enabled prompt registry is rebuilt in stable-key order
recent usage is current-user-only and capped at 100
site metadata is tenant-scoped and secret-minimized to id/name
guest 401, missing ai.use 403 and foreign tenant 404
refresh is non-mutating across prompts, usage, sites and approvals
frontend performs GET-only authoritative refetch and never sends a mutation body
frontend renders refreshed prompt/usage/site/approval snapshot only from the server response
acceptance.repository_ci: Focused validation plus normal PR-head security/parity/convergence/acceptance gates and canonical generator enrollment are required before integration; run identifiers are recorded on the PR and Issue #257 rather than invented here.
